backtest_protocol.execution_model: Uranium anchor and candidate stock features are computed from OHLCV rows with Date <= signal_date. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT OHLCV leadership in uranium producers (CCJ/LEU/NXE) may identify demand/supply shocks that spill into liquid nuclear power, small-reactor, and nuclear equipment stocks over the next 10 trading days.
interpretation: The uranium/nuclear relation source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_concentration_failed). Do not promote or tune this fixed relation bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT nuclear demand/supply evidence, such as contract awards, utility procurement, reactor approval events, ownership/flow confirmation, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep anchor lookbacks, candidate thresholds, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping uranium anchor count/ret20/ret5/close-location thresholds, fixed candidate list, RS/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Need PIT event/procurement/flow/ownership evidence or closed forward replacement-value rows before revisiting uranium to nuclear relation leadership.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.9042; aggregate PnL delta $+17,615.86; max drawdown drift +0.0007; 64 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected. Uranium anchor breadth plus fixed nuclear candidate leadership did not add robust replacement value versus the accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration checks (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_concentration_failed). The relation likely relabels a crowded volatile nuclear theme rather than a distinct spillover edge.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT OHLCV leadership in uranium producers (CCJ/LEU/NXE) may identify demand/supply shocks that spill into liquid nuclear power, small-reactor, and nuclear equipment stocks over the next 10 trading days.

2_history_check.exp-20260607-011: Rejected precious metals ETF / producer lag. This run does not use GLD/SLV or precious-metals miners; it uses uranium producer breadth as the anchor and nuclear utilities/reactor/equipment stocks as the candidate universe.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-001: Rejected copper/cyclical relation work; this run is a distinct nuclear supply/demand theme and fixed ticker set.
2_history_check.exp-20260619-021: Rejected TLT rate-relief growth leadership. This run does not use macro duration proxies or QQQ-vs-SPY growth context.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: Novelty gate warned on generic OHLCV leadership families. The override declares a new evidence axis: uranium producer anchors to a fixed nuclear power/equipment universe, not GLD/SLV producer lag, copper-growth, rate-relief growth, broad leadership, or AI power fixed universe.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior GLD/SLV producer-lag and copper/growth relation scouts failed, but this tests a distinct uranium/nuclear relation with broad PIT OHLCV warehouse coverage and no SEC/LLM dependency. Main risk is that it collapses into generic volatile theme beta after next-open execution and costs.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing anchor/candidate OHLCV, failed uranium anchor breadth, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $8 and ADV20 >= $25M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same uranium anchor breadth, fixed nuclear candidate universe, liquid constructive candidate gates, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
